nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, declared in the owned base contract and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Mapping (uint8 => address) storing enrolled players indexed by ticket number.
uint8 counter of enrolled players; used as the current lottery index.
LotteryState enum tracking whether the lottery is Accepting or Finished.
Public uint8 maximum number of players allowed (default 55).
Public uint minimum ether amount required to enroll (default 0.02 ether).
Constructor of the owned contract that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function that transfers contract ownership to newOwner.
Constructor of MMaker that sets the lottery state to Accepting.
Payable function that enrolls msg.sender as a player after checking the minimum payment.
Owner-only function to change the maximum number of players.
Owner-only function to change the minimum enrollment amount.
View function returning the current player number and the last enrolled player address.
Owner-only function that draws a pseudo-random winning number and distributes funds.
Owner-only function that clears the players mapping and resets the lottery state.
Private function that pays 10% of the balance to the owner and the rest to the winning player.
Internal pseudo-random number generator based on block.timestamp and the players mapping.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, enrollment and player indexing.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the randomness seed in randomtest.
Unchecked uint8 increment 'number += 1' inside enroll, vulnerable to arithmetic overflow at 255.
owner.transfer(this.balance/10) external value transfer with unchecked division.
players[winningNumber].transfer(this.balance) external call to an attacker-controlled address while state is still mutable.
Weak randomness: keccak256(block.timestamp) used as the lottery seed, predictable by miners.
Address parameter of transferOwnership that becomes the new owner.
uint8 parameter of setMaxNumber written into maxnumber.
uint parameter of setMinAmount written into minAmount.
uint8 parameter of distributeFunds used to index the players mapping.
Local variable in determineWinner holding the randomtest result passed to distributeFunds.
uint8 loop counter used in startOver to iterate over the players mapping.
uint8 local in randomtest holding the timestamp hash modulo number.
Return value of lastPlayer carrying the current player number.
Return value of lastPlayer carrying the current player address.

edges.reason: owned constructor assigns msg.sender directly to the owner state variable, making initial ownership caller-determined.
Constructor execution performs the write to the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before allowing transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner parameter into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership updates the privileged owner state variable.
owner value gates execution of transferOwnership through the onlyOwner modifier.
MMaker constructor initializes the state variable to LotteryState.Accepting.
enroll uses msg.sender as the player address that is stored.
enroll writes msg.sender into the players mapping at index number.
enroll increments the number state variable.
enroll executes the unchecked uint8 increment operation.
Current number value is read for the increment operation.
Incremented value is written back into the number state variable, enabling overflow at 255.
number is compared against maxnumber inside enroll's require statement.
enroll sets state to Finished when number reaches maxnumber.
minAmount is read in enroll to require msg.value >= minAmount.
maxnumber is read in enroll's require(number<=maxnumber) check.
owner gating via onlyOwner controls setMaxNumber execution.
setMaxNumber writes the newNumber parameter into maxnumber.
setMaxNumber mutates the maxnumber state variable.
owner gating via onlyOwner controls setMinAmount execution.
setMinAmount writes the newAmount parameter into minAmount.
setMinAmount mutates the minAmount state variable.
lastPlayer reads the number state variable.
lastPlayer reads players[number] from the mapping.
lastPlayer assigns the current number to the _number return variable.
lastPlayer assigns players[number] to the _Player return variable.
onlyOwner modifier restricts determineWinner to the owner.
determineWinner calls randomtest to obtain the winning number from a timestamp-dependent seed.
randomtest return value flows back into determineWinner as winningNumber.
determineWinner stores the randomtest result in the winningNumber local variable.
winningNumber local is passed as the argument to distributeFunds.
determineWinner invokes distributeFunds.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 weak-randomness computation.
randomtest depends on block.timestamp, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
randomtest executes the keccak256(block.timestamp) unsafe randomness operation.
randomtest computes modulo number, which reverts or panics when number is zero.
randomtest stores the hash modulo number into the inter local variable.
inter is used as the index when reading players[inter].
players[inter] is hashed inside randomtest, making the seed dependent on attacker-chosen addresses.
onlyOwner modifier restricts startOver to the owner.
startOver deletes entries from the players mapping in a loop.
startOver resets the number counter to zero.
startOver resets state to LotteryState.Accepting.
The i loop counter drives iteration inside startOver.
The i loop counter indexes the players mapping during deletion.
distributeFunds performs owner.transfer(this.balance/10) with unchecked integer division.
The owner address receives the 10% transfer.
distributeFunds sends the remaining balance to the winning player via an external call.
The winningNumber parameter selects the players mapping entry that becomes the external call target.
players[winningNumber] controls the destination of the external value transfer.
The external transfer to an attacker-controlled player address can re-enter distributeFunds before state is finalized.
winningNumber parameter flow within distributeFunds determines the reentrancy-exposed transfer target.
Winning number derived from timestamp-dependent randomness flows back into the owner-only winner selection.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter is only used to assign the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Parameter is only used to write the maxnumber state variable inside setMaxNumber.
Parameter is only used to write the minAmount state variable inside setMinAmount.
Parameter is only used inside distributeFunds to index players and select the transfer target.
Local variable only carries the randomtest result into the distributeFunds call inside determineWinner.
Loop counter exists solely to drive the deletion loop inside startOver.
Local variable only holds the intermediate hash modulo number inside randomtest.
Return variable is populated and returned only by lastPlayer.
